text_block_list.text:
Without a moment's notice, we're called
to
action.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Announcement! The Summer Sprint
Series will
begin soon!
text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава

text_block_list.text:
But I ran last year too. Why the special

announcement?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Explanation! If you place well in the
Summer
Sprint Series, something good
will happen...
possibly!
text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава

text_block_list.text:
Awww. That's not enough to motivate
me.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Of course, it's not compulsory! You may
attend
summer camp normally or run in
other races!
text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава

text_block_list.text: That is all! Please think it over!
text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава

text_block_list.text:
And that's what she said. I wonder what I
should
do...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян
choice_data_list: If you do want to run, then...

text_block_list.text:
I suggest the Hakodate Sprint Stakes in
late June,
the Keeneland Cup in late
August, and the
Centaur Stakes in late
September.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's run in the Hakodate Sprint Stakes
before,
and if we want time in between
races to rest and
prepare, these three
are our best bet.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hm... That sounds fun... but it doesn't
really
matter to me. I'll let you decide!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Hm... That sounds fun... but it doesn't
really
matter to me. I'll let you decide!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Looks like I'll need to think long and
hard about
whether it's the right
decision to run in the
Summer Sprint
Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
